title: Mory Kanté, Guinea’s hero, found new ways of playing the old music
text: March 10, 2026 - On his father’s side, the Kantés were blacksmiths who had turned musicians. The balafon, the wooden xylophone with 18-22 keys, was their instrument, though they also played acoustic guitars, transferring the interlocking techniques of the balafon onto the guitar strings.
